options.plugins: which plugins are on or off, if not as they come: {"memory": true, "tap-to-wake": false}
options.name: To wake it, say «Hey» followed by its name. It's also the name it introduces itself with.
options.language: The language it speaks and understands. Each device chooses the language of its screen (Interface Language). If not set, the system's.
options.llm: The one that answers what the basic skills don't.
options.llm_model: For example, for Claude: sonnet, opus or haiku. If not set, the model's own.
options.mcp: A .mcp.json file with external tools. If not set, the one in your data folder.
options.instructions: What it should know about you and how you want it to talk to you.
options.detail: How much it says when it answers.
options.detail_levels: More levels, or other texts for the existing ones.
options.ignore_others: It stays quiet when what it hears is clearly not for it.
options.stt: The engine that turns what you say into text.
options.stt_unload_minutes: After how many minutes without use it is unloaded from memory; it comes back when needed. 0: never.
options.tts: The one it speaks with. «None»: text only.
options.voice: If not set, the language's. It can be one per language.
options.volume: Of its voice and sounds, from 5 to 100%.
options.wake: The one that detects the wake word. «None»: only by tapping the screen.
options.threshold: How sure it must be to wake. Higher: fewer false wakes.
options.vad: The engine that tells voice from noise.
options.silence: Seconds without speech that end a sentence.
options.follow_up: Seconds it keeps listening without you saying its name.
options.echo_guard: Seconds without listening after it speaks, so it doesn't hear itself.
options.pause_when_microphone_busy: It stops listening while another app uses the device's microphone (a call, a meeting), and comes back when it ends.
options.listen_while_speaking: It keeps listening while it speaks and stops if someone talks over it. It tells its own echo from a voice by comparing loudness with what it sends. Experimental.
options.echo_match: How alike the loudness of what it hears must be to what it sends to count as its own echo, from 0 to 1.
options.fillers: It says «One moment, let me check» when something takes a while.
options.skills: Time, date, timers, alarms, reminders, sums, units and volume, without the language model.
options.log_transcripts: What it hears and says, for debugging. When off, only their length.
options.host: The one the server listens on.
options.mode: Assistant, Transcriber (only shows what it hears) or Parrot (repeats what it hears).
options.record: Saves everything that arrives as WAV files, for debugging.

packages: Only the packages for the plugins that are turned on.
language: The language it speaks and understands. It can also be changed by voice.
name: Assistant's name
To wake it, say «Hey» followed by its name.
llm: Claude requires Claude Code, installed and signed in. Apple's model requires macOS 26 and Apple Intelligence.
models: Speech recognition, wake word and voice detection. Downloaded once (a few hundred MB).
service: Runs in the background and restarts if it stops.
installer.intel: (Intel: speech recognition on MLX won't work)

options_empty.mcp: the one in your data folder

llm_ready.ollama: Ollama isn't running or has no model

options_title.name: Name
options_title.ignore_others: Ignore what isn't meant for it
options_title.silence: Silence at the end of a sentence
options_title.tap_to_stop: Tap the screen to stop it
